label: Access outcome
meaning: Whether the worker can access the meter for capture
prerequisite_and_requirement: All visits; set by entry action
validation: Exactly yes or no; No Access changes the schema and suppresses asset capture
initial_or_default: From entry action; not a boolean
stored_as: Same payload path

label: No Access reason
meaning: Why the attempted visit could not inspect the meter
prerequisite_and_requirement: No Access; required
validation: Approved local choices; Other must have explanation. Server requires nonempty text; form rejects bare Other
initial_or_default: Blank on No Access; NAv in accessed initial form
stored_as: Same path; Other represented with explanatory text

label: Service / mission
meaning: Which service is being discovered or whether this is a No Access visit
prerequisite_and_requirement: All submissions; inherited from entry selection
validation: electricity or water when accessed; NA when No Access
initial_or_default: Entry action; fallback electricity in draft hydration
stored_as: Same root path

label: Meter number
meaning: Serial/identifier of the actual meter; leading zeros matter
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed discovery, electricity or water; required
validation: Remove all whitespace; uppercase ASCII a-z; allow only A-Z and 0-9. Local duplicate warning uses loaded data; backend master checks remain authoritative. Do not guess unreadable numbers
initial_or_default: Blank; electricity batch route can prefill targetedMeterNo
stored_as: Same path; normalised identity also keys meter_master

label: Manufacturer
meaning: Manufacturer shown on the physical equipment
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed discovery, electricity or water; required
validation: Required. Electricity Other requires custom text which replaces Other before transmission. Water offers Other but has no equivalent helper in the reviewed component: unresolved mismatch
stored_as: Custom electricity manufacturer replaces literal Other

label: Other manufacturer
meaning: Manufacturer absent from electricity list
prerequisite_and_requirement: Electricity when Manufacturer = Other; required
validation: Trimmed nonempty text
stored_as: Folded into ast.astData.astManufacturer; helper deleted

label: Model / name
meaning: Model/name printed on meter
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed discovery, electricity or water; required
validation: Required for water; required after manufacturer is chosen for electricity. No product-wide model enumeration is asserted
stored_as: Same path

label: Phase
meaning: Electricity phase category
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity discovery; required
validation: single or three
stored_as: Same path

label: Meter subtype
meaning: Prepaid or conventional metering
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed discovery, electricity or water; required
validation: prepaid or conventional. Switching to conventional clears remaining-credit inputs and removes its photo
stored_as: Same path

label: Meter category
meaning: Normal or bulk classification
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed discovery, electricity or water; required
validation: Exactly Normal or Bulk. Selecting Bulk alone does not define a network hierarchy or customer-billing arrangement
stored_as: Same path

label: Placement
meaning: Physical mounting/location category
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity discovery; required
validation: Eight controlled options listed below. Other has no dedicated explanation control; use Field Comment
stored_as: Same path
evidence: Context photo may be added; no dedicated placement tag

label: Meter GPS
meaning: Confirmed physical meter position
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed discovery, electricity or water; required
validation: Finite coordinates, latitude -90..90, longitude -180..180, not 0/0. Validator uses numeric conversion. No parcel-containment or accuracy threshold is enforced here
initial_or_default: Null until confirmation; map can initialise at premise centroid
stored_as: Same path
evidence: Map pin is separate from media GPS

label: Meter status
meaning: Connection state observed during discovery
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed discovery, electricity or water; required
validation: CONNECTED or DISCONNECTED; neither a QA verdict nor Sales visibility
stored_as: Root status.state; projected to asset

label: Seal number
meaning: Identifier read from the associated equipment
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity discovery; value OR comment required
validation: A nonempty value requires its tagged photo. Comments are alternatives to a missing value, not substitutes for reading a visible identifier
stored_as: Same path; nonempty value clears canonical comment

label: Seal comment
data_type: enum string or canonical free text
meaning: Explanation when the associated value could not be captured
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity discovery; required if value blank
validation: Select approved reason; Other needs explanatory text. Certain reasons require evidence; see matrix. Bare Other rejected by server
stored_as: Same path; Other helper becomes the actual explanation

label: Seal Other reason
meaning: Specific reason not covered by list
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity discovery; required when corresponding value blank and comment = Other
validation: Trimmed nonempty text
stored_as: Folded into ast.astData.meter.seal.comment; helper deleted
synthetic_example: Identifier plate obscured by an unreadable label
evidence: No automatic extra photo for custom reason

label: Keypad number
meaning: Identifier read from the associated equipment
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity discovery with prepaid subtype; value optional in inspected schema
validation: A nonempty value requires its tagged photo. Comments are alternatives to a missing value, not substitutes for reading a visible identifier
stored_as: Same path; nonempty value clears canonical comment

label: Water meter reading
meaning: Opening/current register observation made at discovery
prerequisite_and_requirement: Water conventional; required
validation: Nonempty reading; numeric-oriented UI. Reviewed schema/server validate presence rather than a complete decimal/unit/range contract
stored_as: mreadings[0].reading with readingAt, trnId and source AST_CREATION; removed from ast

label: Water token reading
meaning: Prepaid water token-reading input shown by this form
prerequisite_and_requirement: Water prepaid; required
validation: Nonempty reading; numeric-oriented UI. Meaning, unit and distinction from remaining credit need owner clarification
stored_as: treadings[0].tokenReading with readingAt, trnId and source AST_CREATION; removed from ast

label: Remaining credit
meaning: Prepaid balance displayed by meter
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed prepaid electricity or water discovery; value OR reason required
validation: Pattern ^[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$; zero and negative values allowed. No commas, exponent notation or unit suffix. Unit is not specified by this contract
stored_as: Same path on prepaid; removed on conventional

label: Remaining credit reason
meaning: Why the prepaid balance could not be captured
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed prepaid electricity or water discovery; required only if value blank
validation: Approved reason or Other with details. Must be blank when value captured; placeholder zero must not replace an unknown value
stored_as: Same path; Other canonicalised to Other: followed by text
evidence: No remaining-credit photo required when no value

label: Other remaining credit reason
meaning: Custom explanation for missing balance
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed prepaid electricity or water discovery with blank value and reason Other; required
validation: Trimmed nonempty text
stored_as: Folded into remainingCreditComment with Other: prefix; helper deleted

label: Primary finding / anomaly
meaning: Principal observation about meter condition
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed discovery, electricity or water; required
validation: Select listed finding. Form and server require nonempty text; do not assume backend comprehensively checks every finding/detail pairing
stored_as: Same path; transaction records as-found observation

label: Finding detail
meaning: Specific observation within selected finding
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed discovery, electricity or water; required
validation: Required once finding selected; choose detail associated with it. Water applicability of shared electricity-oriented options remains under review
stored_as: Same path
evidence: anomalyPhoto for every detail except Operationally Ok

label: Other anomalies
meaning: Additional observations alongside primary finding
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity/water; optional
validation: Approved five values; no duplicates. Not a free-text replacement for the principal finding
stored_as: Same path, canonical array
evidence: No separate evidence tag mandated; explain/evidence relevant finding

label: Off-grid supply
meaning: Recorded presence of off-grid supply at site
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity discovery; required
validation: UI yes/no. Backend checks nonempty value and requires photo when yes; do not infer a full energy-source inventory or capacity field
stored_as: Same path

label: Normalisation actions
meaning: On-site response and/or requested follow-on job
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity discovery; required answer
validation: Nonempty list; no duplicates; None exclusive; at most one job; expected job omitted requires reason. Mobile preselects expected action on finding change
stored_as: Same path in newer normalisation contract; incompatible action labels exist in older branch
evidence: normalisationPhoto for on-site fix; not for job-only choice

label: Reason for not acting
meaning: Why the expected disconnect/replace job was not selected
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity discovery when expected action omitted; required
validation: Choose reason or Other with text. Reason must be empty when expected job selected or finding needs no job. Current server accepts canonical custom explanation
stored_as: Same path; Other replaced with helper text

label: Other no-action reason
meaning: Custom reason for not doing expected work
prerequisite_and_requirement: Accessed electricity discovery with reason Other; required
validation: Trimmed nonempty explanation
stored_as: Folded into noActionReason; helper deleted

label: Field comment
meaning: Additional site explanation or unresolved ambiguity
prerequisite_and_requirement: Every route; optional
validation: Trimmed text; no maximum length established in inspected discovery schema
stored_as: Same path
synthetic_example: Meter in shared roadside kiosk; serves Unit B

label: Tagged media
meaning: Pictures/recordings supporting specific fields or commentary
prerequisite_and_requirement: Every route; particular tags conditionally required
validation: Required tags below. Server checks nonempty uri or url; several client checks test tag presence only. Upload/quality is a separate concern
stored_as: Root media; core meter tags projected to asset; comment media retained with transaction
